text: 在8月28日的中期业绩发布会上，中国人寿总裁利明光用“多项指标再创历史新高”来概括上半年经营成绩。半年报显示：上半年，公司首年期交保费1012.94亿元，同比增长24.7%。“这是公司首年期交保费半年首破千亿。”他说。价值指标同步走高。利明光称，新业务价值快速增长，上半年新业务价值381.67亿元，同比增长33.7%。同时，净利润同比大幅提升。体量指标亦创新高。利明光表示，公司内含价值稳居行业首位、总资产规模突破8万亿元。（上证报）
text_en: At the interim results conference on August 28, China Life President Li Mingguang summarized the first-half performance as "multiple indicators hitting new historical highs." The interim report shows that first-year regular premiums reached 101.294 billion yuan in the first half, up 24.7% year-on-year. "This is the first time first-year regular premiums have surpassed 100 billion yuan in a half-year period," he said. Value indicators also rose in tandem. Li noted that new business value grew rapidly, reaching 38.167 billion yuan in the first half, up 33.7% year-on-year. Net profit also improved significantly year-on-year. Scale indicators also set new highs. Li said the company's embedded value remains the highest in the industry, and total assets exceeded 8 trillion yuan. (Shanghai Securities News)
